描述_EN: the surface is decorated with a frieze depicting animals and archers; the lid is in the shape of a mountain emerging from the waves and probably referring to the mythical penglai, or island of immortals, a place that the deceased were supposed to reach after death. this earthenware jar was made and used during the han dynasty (206 bc-ad 220) as a funerary object.
